response.query: How should we combine Likert scales and NLP-derived indicators into a latent construct (SEM/bifactor/measurement-error models)?
response.answer: Combine Likert scales and NLP-derived indicators into a latent construct using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with bifactor modeling to account for both common and unique variance. Use factor loadings to integrate both types of indicators. Measurement-error models can further refine the analysis.
